workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: The teacher workday shall be no more than four hundred twenty (420) consecutive minutes per day, including a duty-free lunch period of thirty (30) minutes.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: there shall be no more than two (2) building wide staff meetings per month.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Such duties shall include monitoring bus arrivals or departure or student boarding, monitoring the cafeteria, playground, hallways or student restrooms.
